Connect integrations

Bring Jira, Gmail, and Calendar into your workspace.

Connect Jira

  1. Open Settings → Integrations → Jira → Add account with your site, email, and API token.
  2. In Work items → Jira, choose a board and a sprint or backlog.
  3. Open a ticket and choose Start development.

Open in Jira handles anything ByteQuay doesn’t.

Connect Gmail and Calendar

  1. In Settings → Integrations → Google Apps, install the connector and Sign in with Google.
  2. Choose Compose or Reply, then check Review email before Send email.
  3. Save a Gemini API key to use Ask Gemini; it uses your key’s quota.

Mail and conversations stay in memory until you quit.
